part.text:
Fixed. The bug: both `remote-exec` and `file` provisioners only called `comm.Disconnect()` from a goroutine waiting on the provisioner-wide context, which isn't canceled until the end of the whole apply — so SSH connections stayed ESTABLISHED after the provisioner finished.

Changes:
- `internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec/resource_provisioner.go:334` — replaced the `<-ctx.Done()` goroutine with `defer comm.Disconnect()` in `runScripts`, so the connection closes as soon as all scripts have run (or on error), while never disconnecting before a command completes.
- `internal/builtin/provisioners/file/resource_provisioner.go:168` — same fix in `copyFiles`.

Verified in the testbed container: all tests in `internal/builtin/provisioners/{remote-exec,file}`, `internal/communicator/...` pass (including `TestProvisionerTimeout`, which asserts disconnect happens only after the remote command completes), plus `go vet` and provisioner-related `internal/terraform` tests.
